name: qlrisk_simulate_paths
title: Monte Carlo path generation
description: Simulate stochastic-process paths with qlrisk's Monte Carlo library: gbm, ou, cir, heston, vasicek, hull_white, merton_jump. Rate models (ou, cir, vasicek, hull_white) use initial_value as the starting rate and mean_reversion_speed / long_term_mean; heston adds vol_of_vol, correlation, initial_variance; merton_jump adds jump_intensity, jump_mean, jump_std. Returns summary statistics on up to 60 time points, the terminal distribution and a few sample paths (not the full path matrix). Example: {"process": "gbm", "initial_value": 100, "drift": 0.05, "volatility": 0.2, "maturity": 1, "num_steps": 252, "num_paths": 10000}. Bounds: 20000 paths, 1000 steps.
